(I got interested in the topic below  when I began wondering what % of the content I see in explainer videos on AI  posted on Youtube contain inaccurate info about AI and ML, especially if they used AI to summarize or present their info.)

"A Misleading AI Summary Can Warp What You Remember"

Misleading AI summaries cut correct memory recall from 83.6% to 44.8% in a controlled experiment.
